title: HOOD LOCK & RELEASE
summary: Hood locks (the two latch assemblies on the plenum/cowl panel ahead of the windshield that catch the hood) and the hood release cable that runs from the release at the L.H. door pillar to the locks. Each lock is held down by nuts with lock and plain washers on studs that come up from the plate/reinforcement under it; one lock sits on a plate riveted into the plenum-center panel, the other on a reinforcement riveted in place. The cable is clipped to the L.H. pillar with a screw, passes through a grommet, and is clamped to the lock lever by a screw. Related: A8 (hood, hinge, support & catch).

materials.where: cable [6] wire / lock lever area at the right-hand lock view

fastening.to: studs on plate [12] / reinforcement [10] below the lock
fastening.note: Nut [1] over lock washer [2] and plain washer [3] on top of the lock base, both lock views. The studs come up from the plate/reinforcement and have no callout of their own (they are part of the plate/reinforcement or lock, not separate studs).
Plate assembly [12] riveted into the plenum-center panel with rivets [14] at the side and rivet [9] from above (left view). Drill 7/32 holes (7) using [12] as template.

fastening.to: body under the other lock (right view)
fastening.note: Rivets [9] (two callouts) fasten reinforcement [10] under the lock in the right view.
Screw [5] fastens the cable [6] end bracket/clip at the L.H. pillar (release end).
Screw [13] clamps the cable wire to the lock lever; bend wire after assembly.
Grommet [4] where the cable passes through the panel near the lock.
Plug [8] pressed into a hole in the plenum panel (left view).

notes: The center of the shoulder bolts of the lock assemblies must be accurately aligned with the centerline of the mating openings in the lock covers before the lock nuts are torqued.
